## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome and link the issue or plan task.

## Approval and compatibility

- [ ] No approval gate applies, or required ADRs are linked and approved.
- [ ] Public APIs, persisted data, financial semantics, and generated contracts remain compatible, or the change and migration are documented.
- [ ] Module ownership and dependency boundaries remain valid.

## Security and data

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, account identifiers, real statements, or personal portfolio data are included.
- [ ] New permissions, external data sharing, logging, retention, and deletion effects are documented.
- [ ] Broker and document inputs are treated as untrusted.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant format, lint, type, unit, property, integration, contract, migration, browser, accessibility, and security checks pass.
- [ ] Failure, retry, stale, partial, and unauthorized behavior is tested where applicable.
- [ ] User-assisted testing is documented without sharing sensitive data, or is not required.
- [ ] Documentation and the implementation-plan ledger are updated.

## Evidence

List commands run and safe results. Do not attach unredacted logs or financial documents.
